_comment: Design targets for a new player's first days. firstReachRun[i] = run when island i+1 is first reached. Typical player skill at run r = skillMax*(1-exp(-(r-1)/learnTau)) (bot profile interpolation novice->good). clearTarget = share of attempts that cross island i+1 with its designed upgrades (island-specs expect.upgrades). Used by tools/calibrate-islands.mjs and tools/run-sim.mjs.
